-- A project database belongs to exactly one project.
CREATE TABLE projects (
    id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    singleton    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 UNIQUE CHECK (singleton = 1),
    root_path    TEXT NOT NULL,  -- last known state root (main working tree)
    db_path      TEXT NOT NULL,  -- last known absolute database path
    copied_from  TEXT,           -- project id this copy was made from
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at   TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

-- Working trees (main + linked) sharing the project database. Keyed by the
-- per-worktree git dir, which is stable across 'git worktree move'.
CREATE TABLE worktrees (
    id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),
    git_dir       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    path          TEXT NOT NULL,
    linked        INTEGER NOT NULL,
    branch        TEXT NOT NULL,   -- '' when detached
    head_commit   TEXT NOT NULL,   -- '' when unborn
    detached      INTEGER NOT NULL,
    first_seen_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_seen_at  TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

-- One row per downstream provider call, for observability (latency, size,
-- failures). Pruned to the most recent rows by the writer.
CREATE TABLE provider_calls (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    at             TEXT NOT NULL,
    provider       TEXT NOT NULL,
    capability     TEXT NOT NULL,
    query          TEXT NOT NULL,
    items          INTEGER NOT NULL,
    response_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    duration_ms    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    error          TEXT
) STRICT;

CREATE INDEX provider_calls_provider_at ON provider_calls (provider, at);

-- Durable, typed project memory. One short statement per row; raw chat
-- transcripts are not a supported representation.
CREATE TABLE memories (
    id               TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    type             TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN
                       ('goal', 'constraint', 'decision', 'fact', 'open_question', 'warning', 'convention')),
    content          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(content) BETWEEN 1 AND 4000),
    content_hash     TEXT NOT NULL,  -- of normalized content, for exact-duplicate detection
    scope_kind       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope_kind IN ('project', 'path', 'subsystem', 'branch')),
    scope_value      TEXT NOT NULL,  -- '' for project scope
    -- Provenance: who/what recorded it and where it came from.
    source_type      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_type IN ('agent', 'user', 'import', 'system')),
    source_ref       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(source_ref) > 0),
    created_by       TEXT NOT NULL,  -- client that stored it, e.g. "claude-code 2.1"
    confidence       REAL CHECK (confidence IS NULL OR (confidence >= 0 AND confidence <= 1)),
    superseded_by    TEXT REFERENCES memories (id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
    supersede_reason TEXT,
    valid_from       TEXT,
    valid_until      TEXT,
    created_at       TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at       TEXT NOT NULL,
    CHECK ((scope_kind = 'project') = (scope_value = ''))
) STRICT;

-- At most one current memory with the same meaning in the same scope.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX memories_current_unique
    ON memories (type, scope_kind, scope_value, content_hash) WHERE superseded_by IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX memories_current ON memories (type, scope_kind, scope_value) WHERE superseded_by IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX memories_superseded_by ON memories (superseded_by);

-- Full-text search over content (external content table kept in sync by
-- triggers).
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE memories_fts USING fts5(
    content, content = 'memories', content_rowid = 'rowid', tokenize = 'porter unicode61');

CREATE TRIGGER memories_fts_insert AFTER INSERT ON memories BEGIN
    INSERT INTO memories_fts (rowid, content) VALUES (new.rowid, new.content);
END;
CREATE TRIGGER memories_fts_delete AFTER DELETE ON memories BEGIN
    INSERT INTO memories_fts (memories_fts, rowid, content) VALUES ('delete', old.rowid, old.content);
END;
CREATE TRIGGER memories_fts_update AFTER UPDATE OF content ON memories BEGIN
    INSERT INTO memories_fts (memories_fts, rowid, content) VALUES ('delete', old.rowid, old.content);
    INSERT INTO memories_fts (rowid, content) VALUES (new.rowid, new.content);
END;

-- Audit trail: every change to a memory's status is recorded, so nothing
-- is merged or replaced without traceability.
CREATE TABLE memory_events (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    memory_id  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES memories (id),
    event      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (event IN ('created', 'superseded', 'reaffirmed')),
    related_id TEXT,  -- e.g. the superseding memory
    actor      TEXT NOT NULL,
    detail     TEXT,
    at         TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX memory_events_memory ON memory_events (memory_id);

-- Agent-readable task queue.
CREATE TABLE tasks (
    id                 TEXT PRIMARY KEY,  -- e.g. HAR-0024, TASK-0001
    milestone          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    title              TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(title) > 0),
    type               TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'feature'
                         CHECK (type IN ('feature', 'bug', 'chore', 'spike', 'docs', 'test', 'process')),
    priority           TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium' CHECK (priority IN ('low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical')),
    status             TEXT NOT NULL
                         CHECK (status IN ('backlog', 'ready', 'claimed', 'in_progress', 'review', 'done', 'blocked')),
    goal               TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    scope              TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',  -- JSON array of paths
    validation         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',  -- JSON array of commands
    notes              TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    blocked_reason     TEXT,
    -- Claim and lease.
    claimant           TEXT,
    claim_token        TEXT,
    claimed_at         TEXT,
    lease_until        TEXT,
    -- Completion evidence.
    completion_summary TEXT,
    completion_commit  TEXT,
    completion_checks  TEXT,  -- JSON array of {command, result, output}
    completed_by       TEXT,
    completed_at       TEXT,
    -- Bookkeeping.
    source             TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual',  -- manual | import:<file>
    ordinal            INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,      -- backlog order, for deterministic ranking
    created_at         TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at         TEXT NOT NULL,
    CHECK ((status IN ('claimed', 'in_progress', 'review')) = (claimant IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK ((status = 'done') = (completed_at IS NOT NULL))
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX tasks_status ON tasks (status, milestone);

-- Normalized dependency edges: task_id depends on depends_on.
CREATE TABLE task_dependencies (
    task_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id),
    depends_on TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id),
    PRIMARY KEY (task_id, depends_on),
    CHECK (task_id <> depends_on)
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX task_dependencies_reverse ON task_dependencies (depends_on);

-- Acceptance criteria and their reported results.
CREATE TABLE task_acceptance (
    task_id   TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id),
    idx       INTEGER NOT NULL,  -- 1-based
    criterion TEXT NOT NULL,
    result    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (result IN ('pending', 'pass', 'fail', 'n/a')),
    evidence  TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (task_id, idx)
) STRICT;

-- Audit trail of every state change.
CREATE TABLE task_events (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    task_id     TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks (id),
    event       TEXT NOT NULL,
    from_status TEXT,
    to_status   TEXT,
    actor       TEXT NOT NULL,
    detail      TEXT,
    at          TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX task_events_task ON task_events (task_id);

-- Git-aware synchronization state (M5).

-- Last synchronized state per worktree (HAR-0031).
CREATE TABLE sync_state (
    worktree_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES worktrees (id),
    branch       TEXT NOT NULL,    -- '' when detached
    head_commit  TEXT NOT NULL,    -- '' when unborn
    detached     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    dirty        INTEGER NOT NULL, -- uncommitted changes at sync time
    dirty_paths  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    synced_at    TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

-- Content hashes of synchronized files, per worktree (HAR-0033).
CREATE TABLE files (
    worktree_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES worktrees (id),
    path        TEXT NOT NULL,     -- relative to the worktree root, '/'-separated
    hash        TEXT NOT NULL,     -- sha256 of the content (or of the link target for symlinks)
    size        INTEGER NOT NULL,
    mtime_ns    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    updated_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (worktree_id, path)
) STRICT;

-- Incremental sync bookkeeping (HAR-0034).

-- Paths that differed from HEAD at the last sync: re-checked next time so
-- a reverted edit is noticed even though it no longer differs from base.
ALTER TABLE sync_state ADD COLUMN pending TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]';
-- Set when files changed but a provider refresh failed; retried next sync.
ALTER TABLE sync_state ADD COLUMN providers_stale INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;

-- One row per sync run, for observability and failure diagnosis.
CREATE TABLE sync_runs (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    worktree_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES worktrees (id),
    started_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    finished_at TEXT,
    mode        TEXT NOT NULL,          -- incremental | full | since
    reason      TEXT,                   -- why a full rescan was used
    base_commit TEXT,
    head_commit TEXT,
    added       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    changed     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    removed     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    unchanged   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    hashed      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    providers   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', -- JSON [{name, status, detail}]
    status      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('running', 'ok', 'partial', 'failed')),
    error       TEXT
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX sync_runs_worktree ON sync_runs (worktree_id, id);

-- Memory proposals: candidate goals, constraints, decisions, conventions...
-- noticed during work and waiting for approval. A proposal is not active
-- memory; approving it stores a memory (possibly superseding another).
-- Like memories, one short statement each; never transcripts.
CREATE TABLE memory_proposals (
    id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    type          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN
                    ('goal', 'constraint', 'decision', 'fact', 'open_question', 'warning', 'convention')),
    content       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(content) BETWEEN 1 AND 4000),
    content_hash  TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope_kind    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (scope_kind IN ('project', 'path', 'subsystem', 'branch')),
    scope_value   TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_type   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source_type IN ('agent', 'user', 'import', 'system')),
    source_ref    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(source_ref) > 0),
    proposed_by   TEXT NOT NULL,
    rationale     TEXT,           -- why it was proposed, one line
    supersedes    TEXT,           -- memory the proposer thinks this replaces
    status        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected')),
    decided_by    TEXT,
    decided_at    TEXT,
    decision_note TEXT,
    memory_id     TEXT REFERENCES memories (id),  -- the memory an approval stored or reaffirmed
    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
    CHECK ((scope_kind = 'project') = (scope_value = ''))
) STRICT;

CREATE INDEX memory_proposals_status ON memory_proposals (status, created_at);
-- At most one pending proposal with the same meaning in the same scope.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX memory_proposals_pending_unique
    ON memory_proposals (type, scope_kind, scope_value, content_hash) WHERE status = 'pending';

-- Context telemetry (HAR-0144): what get_context returned, and whether the
-- work that followed touched it. Local only; retention is bounded by the
-- telemetry package.
CREATE TABLE context_calls (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    at          TEXT NOT NULL,
    worktree_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    head        TEXT NOT NULL,        -- HEAD commit when the context was served
    task        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(task) <= 2000),
    budget      INTEGER NOT NULL,
    used        INTEGER NOT NULL,
    resolved_at TEXT,                 -- when outcomes were joined
    resolved_by TEXT,                 -- sync or task
    outcome_to  TEXT                  -- commit the outcome was measured at
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX context_calls_open ON context_calls (worktree_id, resolved_at);

-- One row per returned code unit and reporting provider.
CREATE TABLE context_units (
    call_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES context_calls (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    path       TEXT NOT NULL,
    name       TEXT NOT NULL,
    role       TEXT NOT NULL,
    provider   TEXT NOT NULL,
    capability TEXT NOT NULL,
    rank       INTEGER NOT NULL,      -- position in that provider's answer
    position   INTEGER NOT NULL,      -- position in the returned context
    tier       INTEGER NOT NULL,
    inlined    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    language   TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX context_units_call ON context_units (call_id);

-- Files the following work changed, and whether the context contained them.
CREATE TABLE context_outcomes (
    call_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES context_calls (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    path     TEXT NOT NULL,
    language TEXT NOT NULL,
    hit      INTEGER NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX context_outcomes_call ON context_outcomes (call_id);

-- Callee misses (HAR-0145 evidence): a missed file whose changed function
-- is called by code get_context returned. called_from names that returned
-- file; NULL for other misses and for hits.
ALTER TABLE context_outcomes ADD COLUMN called_from TEXT;

-- Tool and provider metrics (HAR-0150): which MCP tools agents use and how
-- they fare. Pruned to the most recent rows by the writer; local only.
CREATE TABLE tool_calls (
    id             INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    at             TEXT NOT NULL,
    tool           TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind           TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',  -- e.g. search_project's kind
    client         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',  -- MCP client name (claude-code, codex...)
    duration_ms    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    response_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL,
    empty          INTEGER NOT NULL,          -- answered, but with nothing in it
    error          TEXT
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX tool_calls_at ON tool_calls (at);

-- Provider calls that ran out of time, apart from other errors.
ALTER TABLE provider_calls ADD COLUMN timeout INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;

-- Milestones of the task queue: what each one is for and when it is done.
-- Definitions only, imported from the backlog file with the tasks; progress
-- is computed from the tasks.
CREATE TABLE milestones (
    id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,           -- e.g. M16, CHK-A
    title      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    goal       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    exit       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', -- JSON array of exit criteria
    notes      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    source     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual',
    ordinal    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

-- Client hook events (HAR-0151): what the agent did around harness, from
-- the opt-in Claude Code / Codex PostToolUse hook. Tool names, MCP
-- server/tool and repository-relative paths only: never contents or
-- prompts. Pruned to the most recent rows by the writer; local only.
CREATE TABLE tool_events (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    at          TEXT NOT NULL,
    client      TEXT NOT NULL,                -- claude-code | codex
    session_id  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    worktree_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    tool        TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind        TEXT NOT NULL,                -- read | search | edit | mcp | other
    mcp_server  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    mcp_tool    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    path        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''      -- repository-relative; '' when none
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX tool_events_session ON tool_events (session_id, at);
CREATE INDEX tool_events_at ON tool_events (at);

-- The agent session a get_context answer was served in (set by the hook
-- event of that call), for read-after-context relevance.
ALTER TABLE context_calls ADD COLUMN session_id TEXT;
ALTER TABLE context_calls ADD COLUMN client TEXT;

-- Deferred tasks (TASK-0015): set aside by a decision, not blocked by a
-- problem. SQLite cannot change a CHECK constraint, so tasks is rebuilt
-- with 'deferred' allowed; blocked_reason holds the reason for either.
-- Other tables reference tasks, so foreign keys are off while it runs and
-- checked (foreign_key_check) before commit.
-- harness: foreign keys off
CREATE TABLE tasks_new (
    id                 TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    milestone          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    title              TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(title) > 0),
    type               TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'feature'
                         CHECK (type IN ('feature', 'bug', 'chore', 'spike', 'docs', 'test', 'process')),
    priority           TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium' CHECK (priority IN ('low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical')),
    status             TEXT NOT NULL
                         CHECK (status IN ('backlog', 'ready', 'claimed', 'in_progress', 'review', 'done', 'blocked', 'deferred')),
    goal               TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    scope              TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    validation         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    notes              TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    blocked_reason     TEXT,  -- why blocked, or when to bring a deferred task back
    claimant           TEXT,
    claim_token        TEXT,
    claimed_at         TEXT,
    lease_until        TEXT,
    completion_summary TEXT,
    completion_commit  TEXT,
    completion_checks  TEXT,
    completed_by       TEXT,
    completed_at       TEXT,
    source             TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual',
    ordinal            INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at         TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at         TEXT NOT NULL,
    CHECK ((status IN ('claimed', 'in_progress', 'review')) = (claimant IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK ((status = 'done') = (completed_at IS NOT NULL))
) STRICT;
INSERT INTO tasks_new SELECT * FROM tasks;
DROP TABLE tasks;
ALTER TABLE tasks_new RENAME TO tasks;
CREATE INDEX tasks_status ON tasks (status, milestone);

-- Architecture findings with memory (TASK-0030). A project database holds
-- its project's findings; a workspace's knowledge database holds the
-- system findings between its members. Each sync takes a snapshot when the
-- findings differ from the last one; a finding's status says how it
-- changed in that snapshot.
CREATE TABLE finding_snapshots (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    commit_sha TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    taken_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    found      INTEGER NOT NULL,
    added      INTEGER NOT NULL,
    changed    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    gone       INTEGER NOT NULL
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE findings (
    key        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,      -- kind and the units it is about
    kind       TEXT NOT NULL,
    level      TEXT NOT NULL,
    title      TEXT NOT NULL,
    measure    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    finding    TEXT NOT NULL,         -- the finding as last seen (JSON)
    hash       TEXT NOT NULL,         -- what it says, to tell changed from unchanged
    status     TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('new', 'unchanged', 'changed', 'gone')),
    snapshot   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES finding_snapshots (id),
    first_seen TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_seen  TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

-- The author's triage: by design (with the reason, recorded as a decision
-- memory too), back for review (a by-design finding that grew), or made a
-- task. Kept while the finding is gone, so a task's finding shows resolved.
CREATE TABLE finding_marks (
    key           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    state         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('by_design', 'review', 'task')),
    reason        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    level         TEXT NOT NULL,      -- as marked
    measure       INTEGER NOT NULL,   -- as marked: review when it grows
    review_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    memory_id     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    task_id       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    task_project  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',  -- the project whose database holds the task
    marked_by     TEXT NOT NULL,
    marked_at     TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;

-- Agents' proposals of architectural tasks and by-design marks (TASK-0032):
-- nothing changes until the author approves one (which creates the task or
-- the mark) or rejects it. Kept in the proposing project's database, also
-- for a finding between a workspace's services.
CREATE TABLE finding_proposals (
    id          TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    kind        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('task', 'by_design')),
    scope       TEXT NOT NULL,              -- 'project' or 'workspace:<name>'
    finding_key TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',   -- '' for an agent's own observation
    -- basis: the finding's (fact, heuristic), or 'observation': the agent's
    -- own, a model's interpretation
    basis       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (basis IN ('fact', 'heuristic', 'observation')),
    title       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(title) > 0),
    body        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',   -- task: what should change and why; mark: why it is intended
    evidence    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', -- JSON list of places
    status      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected')),
    proposed_by TEXT NOT NULL,
    proposed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    decided_by  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    decided_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    note        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    result      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''    -- the task id, or 'marked'
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX finding_proposals_status ON finding_proposals (status, proposed_at);

-- who proposed a mark the author approved
ALTER TABLE finding_marks ADD COLUMN proposed_by TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '';

-- Tasks agents propose (TASK-0046): an agent never creates a task; its
-- proposal waits in Work › Inbox until the author approves it (which
-- creates the task) or rejects it.
CREATE TABLE task_proposals (
    id          TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    definition  TEXT NOT NULL,              -- JSON: the task as a backlog file writes it, without its id
    reason      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',   -- why the agent proposes it
    status      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected')),
    proposed_by TEXT NOT NULL,
    proposed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    decided_by  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    decided_at  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    note        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',   -- the author's, on rejecting
    result      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''    -- the task id it became
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX task_proposals_status ON task_proposals (status, proposed_at);
